errorSignature: Kysely Pool exhaustion due to per-request instantiation
rootCause: The createKyselyClient() factory instantiated a new pg.Pool with max=10 connections on every invocation, causing connection leaks during 24/7 continuous operations.
resolution: Refactored the factory to memoize the Kysely instance in a global variable (singleton pattern) and configured idleTimeoutMillis and connectionTimeoutMillis on the pool.
preventionRule: Always enforce singleton patterns for database connection pools in serverless/server action environments to prevent connection exhaustion.
